bug_fixed.description: Transfer CFOPs (5152, 5409, 6152, etc.) were incorrectly appearing in CFOP Alerts page because documents uploaded before the fix still had pendente_revisao_cfop=True
bug_fixed.root_cause: The alertas-cfop endpoint did not filter out transfer CFOPs from existing documents that were uploaded before CFOPs were removed from CFOPS_OPERACOES_DISTINTAS_UPLOAD
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Added is_cfop_transferencia() filter to both alertas-cfop endpoints to exclude transfer CFOPs even for documents with pendente_revisao_cfop=True
bug_fixed.before_fix: 48 alertas, 83 produtos pendentes (27 were transfer CFOPs)
